explanation: Lemma 4.1 itself asserts, solely by citation, that the minimization-defined functions h_j are valuated matroids and satisfy h_j \preceq h_{j+1}. The reviewer’s objection is exactly that this relative valuated Higgs-lift construction is not proved by the cited sources or in the submission, so the flaw is in Lemma 4.1’s own proof rather than in a later block invoking it.
